dashboard_label: reference configuration, not a verified Saudi system

config.fast_layer: 1 s rows during dispenser fills, compressor transitions (+/-120 s) and events (PRV lift, P > PAH, leak/rupture onset)
config.compressor_stop: stop pressure compensated to a design gas temperature (60 C reference; 70 C dark-vessel stress case; 65 C low class); MOP is the rating at that temperature; stop_mode='fixed' stops at the raw MOP

unseen_policy: ONE-SHOT: score the unseen units once, after every model choice and threshold is frozen on dev/LOMO data (own profile seed and episode seeds).

dashboard.status: REFERENCE - not a verified Saudi system

alarm_load.operator_norm: EEMUA 191 / ISA-18.2: about 6 per hour average is manageable; 12 per hour is the busy ceiling
alarm_load.agent_target: no more than about 1 agent alert per hour of healthy operation

dashboard.provisional: PROVISIONAL: static-alarm limits are PAH 1.02 x MOP, PAHH 1.05 x MOP (Addendum 1), gas temperature 85/100 C (JUDGE) and hydrogen 25/50 %LFL (INL); no real Saudi alarm settings are public

sensor_view.aggregation: channels faster than the 1 s grid are averaged over 1/period native samples; slower channels hold the last reading

valve_states.note: default ON for CGH2; run the ablation with valve_states=False

historian.level: reference configuration (STD) for the filters; deadbands per channel, compdev and fault rates are placeholders (Q10)
historian.layer_note: applied separately to the 60 s and the 1 s layer

static_alarm_basis: live DCS value (before the historian side channel), dashboard tags only
static_alarm_status: PROVISIONAL: static-alarm limits are PAH 1.02 x MOP, PAHH 1.05 x MOP (Addendum 1), gas temperature 85/100 C (JUDGE) and hydrogen 25/50 %LFL (INL); no real Saudi alarm settings are public

register_conflicts_resolved.resolved_as: instruction: compressor stops at MOP -> MOP is the rating at the 60 C reference gas temperature; the compressor stops at the temperature-compensated MOP (fixed stop kept as stop_mode='fixed')
register_conflicts_resolved.source: medium/high classes, light vessel: the fixed stop at MOP leaves almost no thermal margin (peak 1.018 x MOP against PAH at 1.02 over 120 random units; the generated unseen unit U01 alarmed in 3 healthy segments once sensor error was added: cool start, afternoon sun +9 K = +9 bar). Compensated at 60 C: 0/120 alarming, peak 1.003 x MOP

register_conflicts_resolved.source: temperature-compensated compressor stop for the low class: 2% of 50 bar (PAH) is 1 bar = 6 K of margin at 0.168 bar/K, so a fixed stop at MOP alarms in 12/12 healthy runs
